series_level_findings: Google Groups' comp.org.acm archive (1991-1998) is readable unauthenticated through within-group search URLs (https://groups.google.com/g/comp.org.acm/search?q=...) in a real browser; global Google Groups search needs sign-in. Pages are a JS app, so the capture pipeline cannot fetch them with plain HTTP — a browser-rendered save (built-in browser get_page_text, or 'Save as' on the Mac) is needed. The same posts sit behind the usenetarchives.com locators already on file for ecna-1989/1992/1994, scusa-1991, seusa-1993, socal-1994, taiwan-1993 — usenetarchives.com now serves a Cloudflare human-verification challenge (not bypassed). Dragomir Radev (Columbia) posted World-Finals qualifier lists and a per-region results digest in Jan and Dec 1995 — the single best multi-region source for the 1994 and 1995 regionals. The 1992-93 RCD list names every region's director (host institution proxy).
